sources.quote: Implicit caching directly passes cache cost savings to developers without the need to create an explicit cache. Now, when you send a request to one of the Gemini 2.5 models, if the request shares a common prefix as one of previous requests, then it’s eligible for a cache hit. We will dynamically pass cost savings back to you, providing the same 75% token discount.
sources.supports: Google states Gemini 2.5 cache hits receive a 75% token discount, which makes the cache read price $0.0375/M when the input price is $0.15/M.

sources.quote: - Released `gemini-2.5-flash`, our first stable 2.5 Flash model. To learn more, see [Gemini 2.5 Flash](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models#gemini-2.5-flash). `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17` will be deprecated on July 15, 2025.
sources.supports: Google's changelog identifies the preview model and its subsequent replacement/deprecation context; the models.dev cache-field edit did not itself mark a provider price change.

notes: Classified as models_dev_fix: Google's implicit caching announcement establishes the 75% cache-hit discount for Gemini 2.5, equivalent to $0.0375/M against the $0.15/M input rate. The models.dev commit reflects adding the omitted cache_read field; available provider sources do not state the exact date implicit caching became available for this preview model.
